risk_note: RV2 by the risk map (apps/api/src/app.module.ts is outside the allow-list; the code is in the agent module, RV1), precedent B1-10q. Admin AI report list and handling, D1 part 2 (D10-1287 ⑤, D10-1310): adminListAgentReports (agent.trace) and adminHandleAgentReport (agent.report) leave planned. Handling lives in the admin module (D10-1539 (b), after the first verify:fast hit the frozen rule [AC-B3-08k#1], BR-AI-02 ③: agent never hands a database handle to a foreign callee): admin opens the transaction, locks and reads the old values through agent's exported read, calls agent's handleAgentReport(trx) (B3-08zf, the only writer of report_status via transitionAgentReport), then writes one agent_report_handle audit row (target agent_messages:<id>, status and note, never the message text) with its own createAuditWriter on the same transaction; refusals write nothing. Path, operationId and contract unchanged. The list's deadline_at / overdue (now >= reported_at + 48 h, injected clock) is one small function, to be shared by B1-10u. app.module mounts admin's AdminAgentReportsModule on the admin entry and gives agent's list a display-name reader already bound to the pool (no handle passed by agent). Host (local-heavy): integration spec/agent/admin-reports + admin-traces 27/27, handoff rule + contract 53, agent + admin unit 720, tsc -b apps/api test / depcruise 0. The implementation was a fresh desktop Claude subagent (model opus) in place of claude -p on the terminal accounts (DESKTOP-common-20261113); the lane fixed one line after the first integration run (forUpdate('m') does not compile a table alias in kysely 0.29 and every handle answered 500; now sql`for update of m`).
